title: Heart of Stone
start: Talk to Ariane at the entrance to the Wizards' Tower.

items.t: Food and combat equipment to fight several enemies level 35-56 (preferably with Ranged or Magic)

recommended.t: Waterskins or an enchanted water tiara to survive the desert heat.
Completing the Crocodile Tears quest grants immunity against desert heat.
Amulet of glory for quick teleport to Karamja.

rewards.t: 1000 Combat XP (2x 500 experience lamps) in one of the following skills: scl | Attack , scl | Strength , scl | Defence , scl | Constitution , scl | Ranged , scl | Magic , scl | Necromancy , scl | Prayer or scl | Summoning

steps.t: Dismiss any followers now. If you recently completed Carnillean Rising, you might have to re-log to start the quest.
Interact with Xenia at the Wizards' Tower entrance south of Draynor Village. [Chat: Accept]
p: Xenia attacks Ariane in front of the Wizards' Tower.

steps.t: End their fight. [Chat: Any › Any]
On the east side of the Wizards' Tower (outside, near the water), talk to Ariane. [Chat: 1 Okay, I'll talk to Kipple.]
Talk to Kipple. [Chat: 1 Yes. › 2 No]
Solve the puzzle.
Dismiss any followers now.
Talk to Kipple and note the location he tells you. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Head to the Karamja Volcano.

sub.t: Kipple will appear near the entrance.

steps.t: Right-click open tracker with Kipple to solve the puzzle.
Enter the portal.
Kill attendants while avoiding the fires until the green bar at the top fills up (takes about 5 minutes).
Talk to FulKra. [Chat: 1 Why was Xenia here? › 1 No, it's not right. › 4 I've got no further questions.]
Talk to Kipple. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Travel to the north half of Entrana, east of the dungeon entrance.

sub.t: A quick way to get there is using the law altar teleport. No weapons or armour are allowed on the island.

steps.t: Right-click open tracker with Kipple to solve the puzzle.
Enter the portal and open the Bik door.
Equip a weapon (three basic weapons are provided) and kill the attendants while staying close to Kipple.

sub.t: Kipple needs to grab 3 unstable attendants.

steps.t: Once Kipple has placed 3 unstable attendants by the door, light them. NOTE - There is a bug where sometimes you light them and nothing happens. If this happens leave out the portal and come back in.
Talk to BikKra. [Chat: 1 What was Xenia doing? › 2 I am sorry mighty one, I'll explain. › 1 They could be useful. › 4 I don't care › 4 I have no more questions.]
Talk to Kipple. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Solve the puzzle.
Head to Taverley and climb up White Wolf Mountain.
Right-click open tracker with Kipple to solve the puzzle.
Enter the portal.
Click the circuit nodes until you match the power.

sub.t: Each circuit node outputs a certain amount of power, but some nodes will consume more power than they generate, causing your total units to decrease instead.
The white spires will redirect power to its other pair.
You need to match the number of power units by activating or deactivating the correct nodes.

steps.t: Talk to WenKra. [Chat: 1 I am not TokHaar. › 1 What was Xenia doing? › 1 Yes, it should be available to all. › 4 I have no more questions.]
Talk to Kipple. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Head east of Sophanem, south of the agility pyramid.
Right-click open tracker with Kipple to solve the puzzle.
Head south and enter the portal.
Search any shelf.
Combine the following (right-click use):
Combine Ariane and the Golem and Golem and I.
Use the 4 combinations on JasKra.
Talk to JasKra. [Chat: 2 Because power corrupts.]
Talk to Kipple. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
Head to the Lumbridge cemetery, south of the church.
Enter the portal for a cutscene. [Chat: Any › Any › Any]
Defeat the boss. The boss can hit up to 2,900 damage. Do not attack the prehistoric abyssal yet, avoid his energy balls. Keep running around the cave until Kipple finds the correct spot.

sub.t: Kill the prehistoric abyssal as normal.

p: Kipple dies shielding you from the abyssal's attack.

steps.t: Talk to Ariane.
Quest complete!
Optional: Talk to Ariane back at the Old Tower to complete the Nano to Kipple, Come in Kipple achievement.
